field_spec.dependencies: task_ids that must be VERIFIED or COMPLETE before this task may start
field_spec.output_files: repository-relative paths this task must produce
field_spec.last_error: exact error text of the most recent failure, or null
field_spec.checkpoint: checkpoint_id recorded when this task last successfully checkpointed, or null

tasks.title: Concept: title, logline, premise, story spine, retention and production plan
acceptance: One original premise with a clear protagonist, want, obstacle and change.
Story spine with beginning, escalation, climax and resolution mapped to a ~5 minute runtime.
Retention plan: hook inside 8s, a turn every 20-40s.
Originality attestation naming zero borrowed characters, stories, dialogue or designs.
Structured JSON brief with title, logline, genre, runtime, characters, locations, story_beats, emotional_beats, visual_style, production_complexity, retention_strategy.
Production complexity assessed against the no-GPU / no-Kaggle constraint.
Research recorded with sources, and each finding mapped to a concrete design decision.
tasks.last_error: turn_budget.costs rows 4-6 attributed costs to the wrong scenes. Row 'B06 Storm crossing, the pole is lost' cost=18 -> 40, but the pole is lost in SC05 (B05) and the 18-turn cost is the tower door in SC06. Row 'B07 Forcing the sealed tower door' cost=9 -> 31 was actually the stair giving way. Row 'B08 The stair gives way' cost=9 -> 22 was actually SC07 exposure. Costs and the 92->1 gauge chain were correct throughout; only the labels were wrong.
tasks.notes: Director-issued deliverable set (MASTER_FILM_BRIEF.md/.json + RESEARCH.md) supersedes the originally drafted concept/*.md file list. The originality attestation now lives as section 10 of MASTER_FILM_BRIEF.md rather than as a standalone file. AGENT_PROTOCOL.md section 9 updated to match.

tasks.title: Production-ready screenplay, shot list and continuity bible
acceptance: Screenplay total runtime equals the locked 302s (window 180-420s).
Every scene carries scene_id, timecode, duration, location, characters, story_purpose, action, dialogue, emotion, props, environment_action and transition.

Every scene is divided into shots carrying shot_id, scene_id, time_in, time_out, duration, action, character_state, character_position, prop_state, camera_intention, sound, dialogue and continuity_notes.
Shot ids unique and matching SCnn_SHmmm; timecodes contiguous with no gaps or overlaps.
Shot count inside the planned 52-60 range; every shot inside the 1.5-8s band.
Zero dialogue - the film is wordless.
The 92-turn budget preserved exactly: 91 spent, 1 at the burner, 0 at ignition, 1 given back.
Cause and effect tracked across scenes; prop state ledger records every loss and recovery.
The socket reveal remains the climax mechanism and the one-turn ending loops to the opening image.
tasks.notes: Deliverable set is director-issued. SCENE_BREAKDOWN content now lives in the 'scenes' array of SHOT_LIST.json; the separate locked/ files were superseded. Generated by 02_SCREENPLAY/build_shot_list.py + build_docs.py and checked by 02_SCREENPLAY/verify_shot_list.py.

tasks.title: Original character designs, bios and world/locations
acceptance: Every character defines name, role, personality, body proportions, height, silhouette, face, eyes, mouth, clothing, materials, colors, accessories, expressions, body language and movement style.
Every environment defines architecture, scale, materials, lighting, atmosphere, time of day, weather and important background elements.
Every important prop defines design, scale, material, purpose and continuity requirements.
Original reference images generated and stored under 03_CHARACTERS/REFERENCE_IMAGES and 04_WORLD/REFERENCE_IMAGES.
ASSET_INVENTORY.json lists every model/texture/material with provenance.
Designs original and documented as such; consistent with the screenplay shot list.
tasks.notes: Director-issued deliverable set: CHARACTER_BIBLE.md + CHARACTER_MANIFEST.json + WORLD_BIBLE.md + PROP_BIBLE.md + WORLD_MANIFEST.json + ASSET_INVENTORY.json. World files placed in the existing 04_WORLD stage folder (not a new 03_WORLD) so downstream references stay valid. Generated from the manifests by tools/build_design_bibles.py.

tasks.title: Beat board, shot list, shot registry and animatic plan
acceptance: Every shot has a unique id SCnn_SHmmm and a frame range.
SHOT_REGISTRY.json created with all 8 stage slots per shot (story/assets/animation/camera/lighting/audio/render/QC) at NOT_STARTED.
RENDER_MANIFEST.json created with one entry per scene and the 5-state render lifecycle.
Sum of shot durations equals planned runtime inside tolerance.
SHOT_REGISTRY.json and RENDER_MANIFEST.json populated from the 58 locked shots in 02_SCREENPLAY/SHOT_LIST.json - no shot ids invented or dropped.
tasks.notes: Contract re-pointed to the director-issued deliverable set (4 plan files + beat board + panel index + the two registries); 9 reference panels in 05_STORYBOARD/panels/.

tasks.title: Render engine decision + buildable 3D models, rigs, materials
acceptance: Render engine chosen and proven executable in this runtime (evidence captured in ENGINE_DECISION.json).
Every inventoried asset exists or has an explicit BLOCKED entry with cause.
Each asset opens/loads without error and is listed in an index with provenance.
tasks.notes: Procedural bpy pipeline; Blender absent locally so local proof is the stub harness (49/49). Contract indexes all present; scripts/scenes/ dirs hold the executable builders.

tasks.title: Per-shot layout, blocking and polish animation
acceptance: Every shot has animation data and SHOT_REGISTRY.json animation slot != NOT_STARTED.
Timing matches the shot's frame range.
No shot is left at NOT_STARTED without a logged error.
tasks.notes: Checkpoint per shot, not per stage.

tasks.title: Camera rigs, lens choices and per-shot moves
acceptance: Every shot has a camera move, lens/FOV and framing note.
SHOT_REGISTRY.json camera slot != NOT_STARTED for all shots.
Camera never intersects geometry or clips through set pieces (checked in QC).

tasks.title: Per-scene lighting setups, VFX and compositing grades
acceptance: Every shot has a lighting setup reference and a grade/compositing note.
SHOT_REGISTRY.json lighting slot != NOT_STARTED for all shots.
Exposure within legal broadcast range at QC.

tasks.title: Music, SFX, voice and mix stems
acceptance: Every scene has music and ambience coverage; no silent gap longer than 6s unless intentional.
All audio is original or license-documented in AUDIO_INDEX.json.
Mix plan targets -16 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1.5 dBTP, 48kHz stereo.
tasks.notes: Only dependency is T02 - audio can run in parallel with visuals from that point.

tasks.title: Timeline assembly, conform and cut
acceptance: EDL lists every shot in order with in/out frames and audio assignments.
Total cut runtime inside 180-420s, target 300s.
No missing shot references.

tasks.title: Technical + continuity QC of scenes and cut
acceptance: Every scene passes preview QC before it is allowed a final render.
Every shot has a QC slot status recorded in SHOT_REGISTRY.json.
Continuity, timing and loudness issues either fixed or explicitly waived with reason.

tasks.title: Scene-by-scene final render and assembly
acceptance: Each scene rendered independently through SCENE -> PREVIEW -> QC -> FINAL RENDER -> VERIFY.
Each verified scene render exists on disk with matching frame count and duration.
A failed scene is re-rendered alone; other scene outputs are never touched.
Concatenated master assembled from verified scene renders only.
tasks.notes: Risk R-001 lives here. NEVER one monolithic render job.

tasks.title: Verify FINAL/FINAL_FILM.mp4 technically - the only completion gate
acceptance: FINAL/FINAL_FILM.mp4 exists, is a valid playable MP4 and decodes end to end.
Duration inside 180-420s, 1920x1080, 16:9, 24fps, h264 yuv420p, AAC audio, +faststart.
Audio present throughout, loudness within spec.
FINAL_VERIFICATION.json records probe output, sha256 and PASS.
Only then may overall_status become COMPLETE.
tasks.notes: Project is NOT complete until this task is VERIFIED.
